name: George Frederick, Margrave of Brandenburg-Ansbach
contribution: Margrave of Ansbach and Bayreuth, as well as Regent of Prussia.
legacy: During his reign between 1557 and 1603 in the Franconian territories of the Hohenzollern he kept peace, rebuilt cities and castles, founded several schools and a university.

checks.lead: George Frederick of Brandenburg-Ansbach (German: Georg Friedrich der Ältere; 5 April 1539 in Ansbach – 25 April 1603) was Margrave of Ansbach and Bayreuth, as well as Regent of Prussia. He was the son of George, Margrave of Brandenburg-Ansbach and a member of the House of Hohenzollern. He married firstly, in 1559, Elisabeth of Brandenburg-Küstrin (29 August 1540 – 8 March 1578). He married secondly, in 1579, Sophie of Brunswick-Lüneburg (30 October 1563 – 1639), daughter of William of Brunswick-Lüneburg and Dorothea of Denmark.
